what: Faqirs: more than half Jogis, bulk of the rest Goshains and Bairagis (no separate numbers)
quote: More than half of .these are Jogis, while the bulk of the remainder are Goshains and Bairagis.

what: At the Kalika Devi gatherings (Chait, Kuar) one-third of offerings go to the Goshains, rest to village proprietors (Goshains as temple attendants)
quote: At Sikri Khurd considerable gatherings occur in Chait and Kuar in honour of Kalika Devi : one-third of the offerings go to the Goshains and the remainder to the village proprietors.

what: Colony of celibate Nanakshahi faqirs under a mahant who nominates his successor; revenue-free grant of 141 acres here and in four other villages, held since Alamgir II; recruit from Brahmans, Khattris, Jats, Banias, Kayasths; teach the granth
quote: In the village there is a colony of Nanakshahi faqirs, who* hold a revenue-free grant of 141 acres, as well as in four other villages of the district.

what: A tank at Kaila built by a Goshain, Kamta Ram, over 100 years ago (pious benefaction, householder or ascetic not stated)
quote: At Kaila there is a second tank built by a Goshain, Kamta Ram, over 100 years ago.

what: Legend: one Ajaipal, a Jogi, built a Thakurdwara and gave the place its name
quote: One Ajaipal, a Jogi, built a Thakurdwara here and called the place Ajaipara, now corrupted into Ajrara.
